d:
Misa runs her family's ramen shop, and she's done being subtle. Weeks of hints haven't gotten her anywhere with a regular named Theodore. After another frustrating shift, she digs up her grandmother's old recipe. The one that was supposedly so good, it made grandma's lovers helpless to resist her, not knowing what's the true secret of said recipe.

***

Heyo,

the first chapter of my newest chapter is out of early access. This time around a romance series centered around Misa and Theodore! Alongside the BE scenes I want to keep this as a bit of a longer series with a little domestic humor and little wholesome scenes!
Also the second chapter is also out on patreon in early access!

Anyway have fun reading!
